releases.name: ✨ v0.1.2 — emojis throughout
releases.body:
## ✨ Emoji update

- 🎯 Goal summaries now show icons for objectives, lifecycle status, token usage, continuation counts and evidence.
- 💬 Added emojis to command and tool descriptions, notifications, errors and installer messages.
- 📚 Updated the README, repository description and CI labels with emojis.

✅ Goal behavior, command names and API identifiers are unchanged. Tested with 17 unit tests and seven real OpenCode server scenarios.

📦 npm package: `opencode-session-goals@0.1.2`. Publisher account: `fir3pho3nixx`.

🤖 Requires OpenCode 1.19.4. See the README for installation and usage.

releases.name: v0.1.1 — restart recovery
releases.body:
Fixes immediate goal recovery after an OpenCode restart. An abandoned state lock now expires after 5 seconds, and the first command retries long enough to recover it rather than returning a server error.

Verified with 17 unit tests, including a fresh abandoned-lock regression, and 7 real-server integration scenarios. The integration suite also passed twice consecutively after the fix.

For OpenCode 1.19.4. Install using the `.tgz` release URL in the `plugin` array of `opencode.json`; see the README. OpenCode 2.x is not supported by this release.

releases.name: v0.1.0 — persistent session goals
releases.body:
Initial release for OpenCode 1.19.4: persistent goals per session, idle-triggered continuation, pause/resume/clear, optional token and continuation limits, and completion recorded with tool evidence.

Validated with 16 unit tests and 7 scenarios against a real OpenCode server using a local test provider, including interruption and restart persistence.

Install by adding this release's `.tgz` URL to the `plugin` array in `opencode.json`; see the README. This release uses OpenCode's v1 API and is not compatible with OpenCode 2.x. Control commands still produce a short model acknowledgement because of a host API limitation.
